title: Handoff Bridge Ticker — Weekly Integration Pulse
content:
Weekly sync notes for handoff / bridge coordination. Lightweight, actionable — meant for field eng + proservices + SRE touchpoints. Meeting: 2029-03-28 10:00 PT. Facilitator: Maya. Duration: 40m.

Attendees:
- Maya Chen (SE lead)
- Ethan Park (Field Eng)
- Priya Singh (ProServices PM)
- Luis Ortega (SRE on-call)
- Zara Ahmed (Customer Success)
- + recording available in #se-handoff thread

Top-line summary:
- Three customers in final validation (Veridian, Tidewater, BlueCove). Veridian needs a minor KV-cache hotfix before final sign-off.
- One customer (Orchid Analytics) paused due to data-path networking ACLs; escalation to Private infra team in progress.
- Canary rollout for model-variant fallback successfully exercised in staging; minor latency regression (p50 +12ms) observed on small batch sizes.

Customer-by-customer snapshot (quick hits):
1) Veridian (enterprise; Dedicated)
   - Status: validation (security + perf)
   - Blocker: KV-cache invalidation under burst loads leads to 2–3% token duplication in traces.
   - Technical note: observed stale prefix entries when autoscaler spins new GPU pods; likely race in cache priming logic (serving-runtime).
   - Action: Ethan to run memory-profiler and capture KV-cache metrics (SE-4821). Due: 2029-03-30.
   - Owner: Ethan Park.

2) Tidewater (PLG → paid)
   - Status: onramp success tests; scheduled cutover to Dedicated next week.
   - Blocker: none critical; small request to lock model version to v2029-03-14-quantized for predictable perf.
   - Action: Priya to update onboarding playbook and confirm billing commit cadence. Due: 2029-04-02.
   - Owner: Priya Singh.

3) BlueCove (healthcare pilot; Private VPC)
   - Status: testing enclave + KMS integration.
   - Blocker: HSM team requires attestation step; waiting on compliance checklist sign-off.
   - Action: Maya to coordinate compliance package and set meeting with security (Zara included). Due: 2029-04-01.
   - Owner: Maya Chen.

4) Orchid Analytics (paused)
   - Status: network ACLs preventing data-plane egress to model-store; customer requested air-gap-friendly flow but needs non-blocking telemetry.
   - Blocker: Private infra networking; ticket opened (SE-4973).
   - Action: Luis to route to Private infra lead and propose a transit-proxy pattern. Due: 2029-03-29.
   - Owner: Luis Ortega.

5) Maple Retail (low-touch)
   - Status: GA evaluation; embedding accuracy concerns surfaced on domain prompts.
   - Blocker: prompt-template mismatch; val set shows MRR drop 4%.
   - Action: Field eng to run a targeted prompt sweep and feed candidate prompts to Optimize. Due: 2029-04-05.
   - Owner: Ethan Park.

Operational & technical highlights:
- Canary rollout notes: we validated fallback routing between model-variant A -> B for fallback under capacity pressure. Canary traffic ramped to 10% of requests for 2 hours; fallback activated twice. Logged p50 latency bump ~12ms when fallback engaged for small batches (<=4).
- Observability gap: token-level cost attribution was missing for a handful of internal test routes; follow-up PR to console tracing is in review: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321.
- Autoscaler tuning: we saw oscillation when requests have heavy prefix-cache misses. Suggested mitigation: extend pod warm-up window to 45s for workloads with high cold-KV miss rate.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: KV-cache invalidation bug could create degraded output continuity for customers with continuous conversations (financial advisory flows).
  - Mitigation: throttle autoscaler when migration events overlap with high-concurrency windows; apply hotfix branch to serving-runtime (branch: se/fix-kv-race).
- Risk: Orchid air-gap constraint may delay go-live by 2–3 weeks.
  - Mitigation: propose transit-proxy pattern + limited telemetry model that meets customer audit needs; offer dedicated onboarding sprint.

Decisions made during sync:
- Approve deployment of se/fix-kv-race to staging by 2029-03-29. If traces show no regressions by 2029-03-31, we will roll to Veridian Dedicated cluster.
- Lock Tidewater model to quantized v2029-03-14 for cutover window to avoid perf surprises.

Open questions / items needing input:
- Security: can BlueCove accept our attestation doc template or need custom language? (Zara to confirm with legal).
- Product: should we add a flag to routing policy to force no-fallback for specific customers during SLA windows? Product to weigh in — Priya assigned to create a short PRD. Due: 2029-04-04.

Action item tracker (concise):
- Ethan: capture KV-cache metrics + heap profiles (SE-4821). Due 2029-03-30.
- Maya: assemble compliance attestation packet for BlueCove + schedule security call. Due 2029-04-01.
- Luis: escalate Orchid ACLs to Private infra + propose transit-proxy. Due 2029-03-29.
- Priya: update Tidewater onboarding playbook; draft PRD for fallback-flag. Due 2029-04-02 and 2029-04-04.
- Field Eng team: prompt sweep for Maple Retail; report candidate templates. Due 2029-04-05.

Notes to self / running context (raw):
- Slack thread: #se-handoff — link pinned to meeting notes.
- Recording: internal drive (see linked_artifacts).
- Related tickets: SE-4821 (KV-cache), SE-4973 (Orchid ACLs), SE-4999 (observability tracing PR).

Next sync cadence:
- Short sync next Thursday 2029-04-04 09:30 PT for decision checkpoint on KV fix and Tidewater cutover readiness.

Appendix (quick diagnostics):
- KV-cache trace snippet (top-level summary): brief replay showed duplicate prefix flush when pod launch and priming overlap; probable culprit: race around priming ack path.
- Canary metrics summary: 10% traffic, fallback events: 2, average cost delta: +1.8% during fallback windows, p50 latency delta: +12ms.

If you want deeper trace dumps or raw profiles, reply to this doc and I will attach artifacts.

-- Maya
